title: A one-language WordPress site answers 'single' to the language steps of Apply and Build instead of failing
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/wordpress-contract-door.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of the case named "a site with no translation plugin has one language".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 10).
The named case is 'ok': retire, relabel and site language answer status 'single' on the plugin's 'unavailable' + 'no translation plugin' answer, and another 'unavailable' answer still rejects.

selectors.plugin answer: {ok:false, error:'unavailable', message:'this site has no translation plugin, …'} (claude-cowork wordpress/cowork/lib/Engine.php)

evidence: 05/10/2026, local stand, develop b21c158bc: Apply on the Design inspiration card ja-kinetic (WordPress, no Polylang) wrote the text, then site_brief ended 'failed': 'this site has no translation plugin, so it has no editions to retire'.
fence: Only the plugin's no-translation-plugin answer becomes 'single'; every other refusal of the three language steps is still thrown and said.
